description:
## Overview

Search for available flights with real-time pricing from multiple providers. The itinerary **must** be sent as a non-empty `legs` array. Each leg follows the provider **SearchLeg** shape: required `origin`, `destination`, and `date` (YYYY-MM-DD); optional `direction` (`OUTBOUND` or `INBOUND`); optional per-leg `filters` that override global `filters` for that leg only.

**Not supported:** top-level `origin`, `destination`, `departureDate`, or `returnDate` — use `legs` only.

## When to Use

- **Listings** — live prices for search results UI
- **One-way, round-trip, or multi-city** — one leg per segment, in order
- **Filtering** — cabin class, stops, price, refundability, times (globally or per leg)

## What You Get

- Offers from multiple providers
- Itineraries with segments, layovers, and durations
- Price breakdown (fares, taxes, fees) and baggage hints

## Key Features

- Multi-provider aggregation in one request
- Global `filters`, `sort`

## Quick Start

**Required:** `legs` (at least one object with `origin`, `destination`, `date`), `adults` (≥ 1), `currency`

**Round-trip:** two legs (e.g. outbound then return with `direction` `OUTBOUND` / `INBOUND`). **One-way:** one leg.

## Booking

The response includes `searchUrl`, the same search on book.maqami.co. Flights are booked and paid only on MAQAMI's website: `post_flights_verify` re-prices the chosen offer and returns its `checkoutUrl`.

cabinClass.description: Cabin class (provider SearchFilters codes only). Same enum as filters.cabinClass.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child (2–11 inclusive, per IATA). Length must equal children count. Optional — omit if ages are not relevant.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for point of sale

filters.description: Optional filters to refine search results

arrivalTimeBefore.description: Filter journeys arriving before this time (HH:MM, 24h)

changeableOnly.description: When true, only show offers with changeable (modifiable) fares

departureTimeBefore.description: Filter journeys departing before this time (HH:MM, 24h)

excludeConnectionAirports.description: Exclude layovers at these airports (e.g. IST, DOH)

excludeOvernight.description: Exclude red-eye flights and overnight layovers

flightNumbers.description: Filter by flight numbers (e.g. SK500, AF123)

includesCarryOnBag.description: Only show offers with carry-on included

includesCheckedBag.description: Only show offers with checked bag included

legDurations.description: Per-leg max duration constraints. Each entry limits one direction (OUTBOUND or INBOUND) independently.

maxDuration.description: Maximum total journey duration in minutes (inclusive). Journeys exceeding this duration are excluded.

maxPrice.description: Maximum total price (offer total, in search currency)

maxStops.description: Maximum number of stops: -1 or omit = any, 0 = genuinely non-stop, 1 = 1 or fewer, 2 = 2 or fewer. Stops include both connections between segments and en-route technical stops inside a segment (segments[].stopCount), so a single flight number with a technical landing is excluded by maxStops: 0.

minPrice.description: Minimum total price (offer total, in search currency)

refundableOnly.description: When true, only show offers with refundable fares

showCheapestOfferOnly.description: Return only cheapest offer per journey

infantAges.description: Age of each infant (under 2, per IATA). Length must equal infants count. Optional — omit if ages are not relevant.

legs.description: Ordered itinerary legs (provider SearchLeg). One-way: one entry. Round-trip: outbound then inbound. Multi-city / open-jaw: additional legs in travel order.

destination.description: Destination airport or city IATA code for this leg

filters.description: Optional per-leg filters overriding global `filters` for this leg

maxStops.description: Max stops for this leg. Counts connections between segments and en-route technical stops inside a segment (segments[].stopCount); 0 = genuinely non-stop.

origin.description: Origin airport or city IATA code for this leg
